title: At-Fault Physical Damage Losses of an Excluded Household Member, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Underwriting Rule
content:
When a household member is excluded from a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, the loss share of the exclusion credit follows the physical damage losses of the last six months at which the excluded driver was found at fault. These losses are read from the claim files of Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage: the fault determinations finding the insured at fault with the excluded driver named, and the claim payments issued on that claim.

## Rule

| Excluded driver's at-fault physical damage losses | Loss share |
|---|---|
| Found at fault at such a loss in the last six months, and the payments on its claim reach the package's at-fault surcharge minimum paid | One half (0.5) |
| Found at fault at such a loss in the last six months, and its claim has no payment yet | Three quarters (0.75) |
| Otherwise | One |

The package's at-fault surcharge minimum paid is 1000 USD on every package: Cardinal Auto Essential, Cardinal Auto Basic, Cardinal Auto Standard, Cardinal Auto Plus, Cardinal Auto Preferred and Cardinal Auto Premier.

The six months run back from the day the credit is worked out, by the date of the fault determination. The payments read are those on the claim of the latest fault determination finding the excluded driver at fault.

## Truth table (hypothetical)

| At-fault finding in the last six months | Payments on its claim | Loss share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 1000.00 | One half |
| Yes | 2500.00 | One half |
| Yes | 400.00 (paid, below 1000) | One |
| Yes | None yet | Three quarters |
| No (latest finding eight months ago) | any | One |
